label: Leaf arrangement
help: Look at where leaves join the stem.

label: Number of petals
help: Count the coloured parts; sepals that look like petals count.

label: Where is the ovary?
help: The swelling that becomes the fruit. Below the petals, or inside the flower?

label: Shape of the flower
help: Look at the top of the flower.

label: Green sepals under the petals
help: Buttercups only: look underneath the flower.

label: Flower stalk
help: Buttercups only: run a fingernail along the stalk.

label: Ligule
help: The flap where the leaf blade meets the stem.

label: Special features
help: Pick one only if you notice it.

label: Light
help: This and the next four habitat questions are calculated from published Ellenberg values. A rough answer is fine.
